text: Where SEC guidance failed, the failure was localized: respondents who found guidance inadequate pointed predominantly to Form PF Section 1c, Item B, which concerns information about the reporting fund.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2447306

isBasedOn.name: Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act

abstract: The majority of the commenters who believed that SEC guidance was inadequate indicated that SEC guidance was particularly unclear with respect to Form PF Section 1c, Item B (regarding Reporting Funds).

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: respondents who rated SEC guidance inadequate
